season.evidence: Web: guidebook-derived pages describe a snow route from the Yodelin lot with the PCT avoided in winter for avalanche chutes; snowshoe reports are spring/winter; Peakbagger logs cluster Jan-May. Stored Dec-Apr kept; May allowed as margin.

otherTracksConsidered.why: 4 Mar 2022, summited, loop; but it starts at the Stevens Pass lot (47.747,-121.088) and uses the PCT corridor, not the Yodelin lot / Nason Creek valley our route text describes.
Report says the party took the PCT specifically to avoid the Nason Creek crossings from Yodelin, so it is an alternative approach.
8 May 2021 one-way traverse out toward the west, starting at the Stevens Pass lot.

notes: Our trailhead pin is correct: mapped data puts Yodelin ski area on US 2 at about 47.767,-121.077 (OpenStreetMap), matching our pin 47.7660,-121.0782. The three recordings start 1.7 miles west at the Stevens Pass ski area and cross our pin on their way north, so the start mismatch is a different approach, not a wrong pin. No pin move.
